speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

bugfix.name: Guided Bug Fix
bugfix.description: Runs bug assess → human review gate → bug fix → bug test on a bug report

assess.name: Idea Assessment Pipeline
assess.description: Runs intake → research → define → shape → decide with a verdict review gate before a manual /speckit.specify handoff

pipeline.name: Guided SDD Pipeline
pipeline.description: Chains specify → clarify → plan → tasks → analyze → implement → converge into one guided run with a single clarify gate and a post-implement convergence loop.

yolo.name: Full SDD Cycle - no gates
yolo.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement without review gates
